prompt: Add a small date-formatting utility module to this TypeScript service.
setup: The repository has no lint style configuration and no established convention in the touched area.
The utility needs a date, a locale, and several optional formatting choices including a boolean.
expected: The file uses a kebab-case name and named exports.
Option shapes are type aliases with readonly properties.
At most two positional parameters carry the essentials; the optional choices, including the boolean, live in a trailing options object.
No any, suppression comments, or default export is introduced.
must_not: Use interface without a declaration-merging or class-hierarchy reason.
Add a lint dependency as an unrequested side effect.
